# No-code overview

Qlik provides multiple connectors via [Qlik Automate](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-automate)
to support
no-code integration and orchestration using APIs on the Qlik Cloud platform, as well
as the [Qlik MCP server](https://help.qlik.com/en-US/cloud-services/Subsystems/Hub/Content/Sense_Hub/QlikMCP/Qlik-MCP-server.htm)
for interactive AI use cases.

## Qlik MCP - Assistant and agentic AI workflows

If you are building assistant, agentic, or generative AI experiences with your own tools,
you can also use the Qlik MCP server to access Qlik capabilities through Model Context Protocol.
For setup and usage details, see [Qlik MCP server](https://help.qlik.com/en-US/cloud-services/Subsystems/Hub/Content/Sense_Hub/QlikMCP/Qlik-MCP-server.htm).

## Qlik Automate - Qlik Cloud Connectors

In addition to the Qlik Cloud connectors described on this page, Qlik Automate
also connects to many third-party services. For more information, see
the [Automation connectors page](https://help.qlik.com/en-US/cloud-services/Subsystems/Hub/Content/Sense_QlikAutomation/connector-blocks/connectors-list.htm)
on Qlik Help.

To learn more about how it can help you automate analytics and data workflows
without code, see the [Qlik Automate guide](https://help.qlik.com/en-US/cloud-services/Subsystems/Hub/Content/Sense_QlikAutomation/introduction/home-automation.htm)
on Qlik Help.

If you're looking to orchestrate your platform deployments, take a look at
the [Platform Operations tutorial series](https://qlik.dev/manage/platform-operations/no-code/overview) to discover how to get started.
